items.title: Lil Uzi Vert Missed His Lollapalooza Birthday Set, But Joined Major Lazer And Dropped A Surprise EP
items.summary: On Friday, stormy weather forced the cancellation of Lil Uzi Vert's Lollapalooza set. “Due to weather issues, Lil Uzi Vert will no longer be performing,” was festival’s Instagram statement, although an onstage announcement referenced “travel complications.” It was shaping up to be a major performance, especially as it coincided with the rapper's 31st birthday.

items.title: Boy George Fires Label Manager Who Blocked His AI Pro-Israel Reggae Song, Drops Diss Track About Soup Dragons Singer
items.summary: Boy George has caused a major stir since releasing his AI-generated pro-Israel reggae track “We Will Dance Again.” He has since been pulled from a production of Jesus Christ Superstar and parted ways with the manager of his indie label Boy George Presents, after the manager refused to release the song. George has also continued to court controversy with more provocative music, including a diss track aimed at Soup Dragons singer Sean Dickson.
